steps.text: Blend the egg white, salt, sugar, mustard powder, and lemon juice in a blender until combined; slowly stream the vegetable oil into the mixture while blending, about 1/4 cup at a time, until thick. Refrigerate in an air-tight container until using.

raw_recipe.headline: Egg White Mayonnaise
raw_recipe.description: This homemade mayonnaise omits the egg yolk.
raw_recipe.name: Egg White Mayonnaise

recipeInstructions.text: Blend the egg white, salt, sugar, mustard powder, and lemon juice in a blender until combined; slowly stream the vegetable oil into the mixture while blending, about 1/4 cup at a time, until thick. Refrigerate in an air-tight container until using.

review.reviewBody: I just made this mayo and I couldn't believe my tastebuds! The taste and texture are just like the store bought version (similiar to Hellmann's). I am so happy to have found this recipe! The mayo found here in Germany is not like the real stuff back home. This is the closest I will ever get. I used what I had on hand, substituting prepared yellow mustard for the mustard powder (I kept the same quantity), and sunflower oil for the vegetable oil. This recipe was quick and easy to make with outstanding results. I had my parents taste test it with the following verdict: my dad and I really liked it and both agreed that it is just like the stuff you buy at the store, but my mom, on the other hand, thought that it had too much lemon. So I would recommend adjusting the lemon flavour to your own taste. Thanks, Jillena, for this wonderful recipe. :-)

Because of food allergies (egg yolk and soy) I'll need to make my own mayonnaise. I did not use vegetable oil (because it's soy based) and despite the warnings of other reviewers, I used olive oil because I forgot to grab an alternative at the store. It's pretty strong. Plus, my blender didn't work well with it so I switched to my food processor half way, which wasn't that much better. It was overbeaten and pretty stiff. Next time I'll use a hand mixer and different oil. Even so, it was fantastic mayonnaise. I'll make it again. I can 't believe how easy it is. Edit: With safflower oil and a hand mixer it turned out great!

The only change I made was to drop the sugar and replace vegetable oil with olive oil. The changes I made were to make it friendly for chronic kidney disease.

It was wonderful, I think the mustard powder is the perfect ingredient in this recipe.
Very good. I add 1 T of sugar or honey and 2 T of white wine vinegar to make it taste more like miracle whip.

I tried the recipe today; my first batch did not emulsify, so I started over in my Kitchen Aid Mixer with the whisk attachment. It came together like mayo in the store, but is has a funny after taste from the vegetable oil. I put it in the fridge to get cold; maybe that will help the flavor. It not, I will try it again with Canola Oil. I also used the whole egg, but I can see that making a difference in the taste.

I have just started a Paleo diet and making my own mayonnaise was a challenge. This is a fantastic recipe and makes the best tasting mayo I've tried so far. If you are worried about the risk of salmonella because of the raw egg, you can substitute pasteurized egg substitute (like Egg Beaters) and it works exactly the same...without the fear of getting sick. :-)

I was thrilled to find this recipe! I wanted a healthier version of mayo, but don't care for the healthier store versions. In reading the other reviews, I was cautious about the lemon juice, so I added 1 tsp at a time. I actually liked the 2tsp. I used stevia(trying to cut out sugar) and canola oil. Next time, I plan to try olive oil. When I took it out of the blender(mine's not the best of blenders), the mayo was a bit lumpy. I stirred it a bit with a whisk and it turned out nice and smooth. Best of all, it tastes great:) Will certainly make again. Thanks for sharing!****Don't waste your time trying to make with olive oil...it'll turn out bitter...trust me!!
We really like this. I use the powder egg whites. I put a little dill weed and tymes in it. It made the besst potatoes salad and for hamburgers. Wow! Iwill make this again when we need it.
I made this for my husbands low iodine diet. With the egg whites and kosher salt, it fits his diet.
Tried this out a few minutes back and it turned out great. I just found that the white of one egg was insufficient hence added another one. A little garlic to give it the Zing of an aioli.
Delicious! I used plain, regular mustard in stead of the powdered one, and less than a cup of oil (my cup spilled before I put it in the mixer ??). It still turned out great!

This is so easy and so good it is CRAZY! It takes less than 8 minutes! Tastes just like Hellman's mayonnaise and you can tweak it with less salt and sugar if you want to. I bought the Canola oil version of Hellman's for years because of my husband's cholesterol problem. They quit making that due to Covid, I guess, because I haven't seen it for months at any store. So I decided I could try to google a recipe and make it myself and this is the best! Try it!

Really easy to make. I had leftover egg whites from a hollandaise sauce, so decided to try this. If you like light mayonnaise, you will love this. If you're accustomed to regular mayo with a fuller flavor, this recipe won't fill the bill. We buy regular mayo. I made my husband a sandwich with the homemade mayo (without his knowledge) and he noticed the mayo had no flavor. Again, if you like light mayo, this is awesome and super easy to make!
Yeh! I'll never buy mayo again! I did substitute avocado oil. In the future I'm going to play around with this, make a garlic mayo!

I have tried making this three times and it never turns out well. Used the whipping setting on the blender once ingredients were mixed. Hubby will just have to do without mayo for a week while on Low Iodine diet
I've made this mayo several times now, doubling the ingredients since the first time. We love that we can have the mayo that our new diet calls for.... Thanks so much!

Have been looking for a decent egg white mayo recipe. Happy I finally found it. One tip to avoid the mistake I made: letting food processor run in between measuring 1/4 cups of oil. Turned out thicker (whipped butter consistency). It tasted fine but the honey mustard dressing I used it in was thicker than normal.
This recipe is awesome..just tried it and got perfect creamy white mayo with no egg yolks!:)
Needed a no-yolk recipe for my husband, who is on a low iodine diet. This was very good and took about 5 minutes. Very close to Hellman's

Great recipe! I tried making this in my blender; however, the consistency was too clumpy (I have a high-capacity Kitchen Aid blender). I started over and just used my electric hand mixer, and the consistency was exactly like store bought. Thanks so much for sharing!
